full_context_review.scope: Complete actual H2 5 and9 prose and source-unit spans; no fixed section5 paragraph minimum or language-length heuristic. Cross-section applicability/meaning is independently reviewed separately.

actual_stored_projection_bodies.scope: All12 protocol fields, complete calculation/input/output, quality requirements/evidence, all measurement/property/unit bodies, source records, full row descriptions/amount evidence/basis/ranges, boundary/allocation/validation and reference fields. Literal and complete source/ancestor context checks are separate.

measurementRules.rule: Use calibrated weighing and unique release records in cp_release for Q; the sole finished reference output is 1 kg. Zero Q retains raw loads without a unit result.

cp_energy or the corresponding protocol collects raw records only. Convert kWh × 3.6 to MJ once; integrated volume is not multiplied by time. Integrate only genuine rates; mass/volume conversion needs independent density for that substance at the actual phase and T/P.

measurementRules.required_property: Native numerator and net product mass
measurementRules.rule: cp_* aggregates raw numerators only. calc_normalize applies manufacture A/Q or gross physical V/Q once; original-cohort services use calc_service and divide by Qc once. Cards do not divide again.

calculationRules.rule: Q = sum of unique first-release net complete-cartridge masses in H. Exclude packaging and rejects; closing newly released FG remains in Q.

Convert each raw record to its actual numerator unit before attribution. Electricity MJ = raw kWh × 3.6. Integrate a genuine rate over its measured interval once; use independently measured substance/state density only where needed. Do not invent factors.

For each exchange maintain opening inherited vector + actual acquired/incurred vector = genuinely unconsumed closing inherited vector + target first-release-cohort attributed vector + evidenced transfers to genuinely other functions. Ordinary waste/reject/sample burdens are not deducted as other functions; related zero-output loads remain visible. Released closing FG and already-performed services are not unconsumed closing vectors. Internal transfers cancel. Do not use a mass fraction to guess a chemical or energy vector. Separate unconsumed raw stock and WIP from released FG.

V is the actual full gross physical exchange in its own native unit. Reconcile each article and constituent independently: opening physical pool + external receipt = closing pool + gross outward movement + actual physical consumption/loss as appropriate. Whole-article and separately supplied constituent ledgers are disjoint or explicitly bridged; cancel internal handovers. X only removes same-side duplicate actual OTHER flows and never stock or opposite-side movements. Each actual packaging pool includes disjoint non-water J_in/J_out as well as its existing measured_external_water_in / measured_external_water_out under calc_packaging; X cannot cancel true increments or closing stock.

For each packaging article separately: Iopening_empty + Iopening_WIP + Iopening_FG + Iopening_reusable + P + I + ER + J_in + measured_external_water_in = Iclosing_empty + Iclosing_WIP + Iclosing_FG + Iclosing_reusable + S + EO + W + J_out + measured_external_water_out. Water already embodied in a supplied article is non-additive content rather than another receipt. Record real natural adsorption/desorption from independent measurements; do not fit water to a residual. Internal reuse cancels. When W is in the one mixed waste total retain originW but do not export its mass again. The opening and closing states and all six article legs are complete actual wet quantities in kg. ER is external return received, EO external return sent, S full gross shipment, W full wet discard. J_in/J_out are independently measured non-water repair, replacement, deposit, residue or other material transfers across this specific packaging-pool boundary not already included in the whole article legs; no repair or material event is presumed. Existing measured_external_water_in / measured_external_water_out remain independently measured actual water transfers, including natural adsorption/desorption with no repair. Split actual wet added/removed material into disjoint non-water J and measured water using actual composition evidence, no default ratio or density. Material/water already inside opening, closing or a whole P/I/ER/S/EO/W is non-additive content, not another increment. Full W contains substrate, retained residue and water once; its nested children are not additional J_out or measured_external_water_out unless genuinely separated before crossing. Matched internal pool transfers cancel on consolidation without another purchase, provider service or Q.

For Q > 0 apply A/Q once for attributable manufacturing burden and V/Q once for full physical movements. A is the actual converted and section-7-attributed burden transferred to first release after inherited-vector reconciliation. Cards and protocol aggregation only reference this result. For Q = 0 retain raw loads and unresolved balances without unit results.

For each original released cohort Qc > 0 normalize only actual H incremental service burden by Qc once and its full gross physical V by Qc once. Retain original delivery reversal and original inherited vector; do not subtract historical manufacture from new Q. Reinspection/rework/redelivery creates no new Q. Qc = 0 or unknown leaves raw services without unit result. Pair/cancel internal Q handover and do not count a logistical dispatch as another product output.

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Preserve full native flow context and actual supplier compatibility including every basename/synonym/comment and CAS and grade and route and form and geography and media and type and all properties. Require the exact referenced property/unit-group version chain before UUID adoption; no latest-version inference. A query candidate is not a direct public-state verification.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: supplier BOM; complete identity and unit evidence

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Use real calibrated measurements and actual composition; never prescribe capacity or unit mass or yield or programming power or recipe or temperature/time or lifespan. Unmeasured core stages remain explicit completeness holds. Ordinary unresolved auxiliary provider identity remains distinct from core methodology evidence.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: calibration; sampling; raw and calculated records

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Retain source-specific scope and adjoining contrary examples. The historical SNES case supports flash assembly and an actual failure rather than contemporary factory yields; HoskBrew supports services rather than a measured SMT recipe. Manufacturing originals do not establish allocation.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: complete originals and source-specific applicability assessment

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Cover the whole declared H and every actual site; keep each exchange inherited vector and opening/closing physical pool. Include starts and stops and idle and clean-up and unsuccessful batches and rework. Document unobserved future services as unknown.
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: lot travellers; stock and cohort ledgers

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: Report original creation coverage and actual reuse-population uncertainty plus rights and copying boundaries and double-count protection. Price and code size and cartridge kg do not substitute for actual activity.

Report independent mass and relevant element/species balances with actual water states and sinks. Keep real mixture totals and origin subledgers non-additive. No fitted density or invented repair/material to force closure; unexplained residuals stay visible.

measurementRules.rule: 采用 cp_release 校准称重及唯一放行记录计算 Q；唯一参考成品输出为 1 千克。零 Q 保留原始负荷，不求单位结果。
cp_energy 或对应协议仅采原始记录。kWh × 3.6 转 MJ 一次；已积分体积不乘时间。仅真实速率积分；质量体积换算须该物质在实际相态温压下的独立密度。

measurementRules.required_property: 分子原单位与净产品质量
measurementRules.rule: cp_* 仅汇总原始分子。calc_normalize 对制造 A/Q 或完整实物 V/Q 各执行一次；原放行批次服务仅由 calc_service 执行一次除以 Qc。卡片不能重复相除。

calculationRules.rule: Q = H 内唯一首次放行完整卡带净质量之和。排除包装及不合格品；新放行期末成品仍含于 Q。
各原始记录先换算至实际分子单位再归属。电力 MJ = 原始 kWh × 3.6。真实速率按实测区间仅积分一次；仅在需要时使用独立实测该物质及状态的密度。不编造系数。
逐交换保留：期初继承向量 + 实际取得或发生向量 = 真正未耗用期末继承向量 + 目标首次放行批次归属向量 + 有明确依据转移至其他真正功能的向量。普通废物、不合格品及样本负荷不作为其他功能扣走；对应零产出负荷保持可见。已放行期末成品和已执行服务不属于未耗用期末向量。内部交接抵消。不按质量份额猜测化学或能源向量。未耗用原料、在制品及已放行成品分别记账。

V 为各自原单位的实际完整实物交换。逐制品和组分独立核对：期初实物池 + 外部收货 = 期末池 + 全部对外流转 + 对应实际物理耗用或损失。整件及单独供货组分账互斥或明确桥接；内部交接抵消。X 仅去重同侧重复的实际 OTHER 流，不冲库存或对侧流转。 每个实际包装池按 calc_packaging 保留互斥非水 J_in/J_out 以及既有 measured_external_water_in / measured_external_water_out，X 不能冲真实增量或期末库存。

每种包装分别满足：Iopening_empty + Iopening_WIP + Iopening_FG + Iopening_reusable + P + I + ER + J_in + measured_external_water_in = Iclosing_empty + Iclosing_WIP + Iclosing_FG + Iclosing_reusable + S + EO + W + J_out + measured_external_water_out。供货制品已包含的水只作为内含子账，不再次加入。真实自然吸脱湿另据独立测量记录；缺测不能用残差补水。内部复用抵消。W 已包含于单一混合废物总量时保留 originW，不再导出其质量。 期初期末各状态及整物品六方向均为实际完整湿态 kg。ER 为收到外部返还，EO 为向外返还，S 为完整毛发运，W 为整湿废弃物。J_in/J_out 为独立实测、跨此具体包装池且尚未含于整物品方向的非水修理、替换、沉积、残留或其他材料转移，不推定发生修理或材料事件。既有 measured_external_water_in / measured_external_water_out 保持独立实测真实水转移，含没有修理的自然吸脱湿。真实新增或移除湿材料依据真实组成证据拆为互斥非水 J 和实测水，不设默认比例或密度。期初期末或完整 P/I/ER/S/EO/W 已包含的料水为非加和内含量，不是另一增量。完整 W 已含基材、留存残余及水一次；除非跨界前真实分离，其嵌套子项不再列 J_out 或外流水。已配对内部池转移合并时抵消，不新增采购、供方服务或 Q。
Q > 0 时归属制造负荷仅求一次 A/Q，完整实物流仅求一次 V/Q。A 是真实换算并按第 7 节归属、经继承向量核对后转移至首次放行的负荷。卡片及协议汇总仅引用此结果。Q = 0 时保留原始负荷及未解决平衡，不输出单位结果。
每个原放行批次 Qc > 0 时，仅将 H 内实际增量服务负荷除以 Qc 一次，完整实物流 V 也仅除以 Qc 一次。保留原交付冲回及原继承向量；不得从新 Q 扣除历史制造。复验、返工和重发不产生新 Q。Qc = 0 或未知时仅保留原始服务，不输出单位结果。配对抵消内部 Q 交接，不将物流发运计为另一个产品产量。

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 保留完整原生流上下文及实际供方兼容性，包含全部 basename、同义词、备注、CAS、等级、路线、形态、地理、介质、类型和全部属性。采用 UUID 前须有精确被引用属性及单位组版本链；不得推断最新版本。查询候选不等于公开状态直读验证。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 供方物料清单；完整身份及单位证据

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 使用真实校准测量及实际组成；不预设容量、件重、良率、烧录功率、配方、温度时间或寿命。核心阶段缺测明确阻断完整性。普通辅助供方身份缺口与核心方法证据分开。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 校准；采样；原始及计算记录

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 保留各来源特定范围和相邻反例。历史 SNES 案例支持闪存装联及一次真实失败，不支持当代工厂良率；HoskBrew 支持服务，不支持实测 SMT 配方。制造原件不构成分配依据。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 完整原件及来源特定适用性评估

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 覆盖完整声明 H 及每个实际场址；保留每交换继承向量和期初期末实物池。纳入启停、空转、清理、不成功批次及返工。未观察未来服务保持未知。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 批次工序单；库存及批次账

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 报告原始开发覆盖和实际复用总体不确定性、权利与复制边界及防重复措施。价格、代码规模和卡带千克不能替代真实活动。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 原始资产数据集；权利及来源；供方覆盖

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 报告独立质量及相关元素和物种平衡，包含实际水状态和去向。真实混合物总量和来源子账非加和。不得拟合密度或虚构修复材料来强迫闭合；未解释残差保持可见。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 质量及物种平衡；独立测量
